title: Oven Toasted Middle Eastern Ciabatta Flatbread
description: A savory and crisp Middle Eastern dish featuring ciabatta, perfect for a monsoon evening, served in a fondue pot with a sweet and tangy glaze.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the ciabatta bread into 1-inch thick rounds.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the bread rounds.
Place the bread rounds on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the bread in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
While the bread is baking, mix together lemon juice and sumac in a small bowl.
Once the bread is ready, remove it from the oven and brush the lemon-sumac mixture onto each round.
Sprinkle crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley over the bread rounds.
Serve the toasted flatbread in a fondue pot, allowing guests to dip into their favorite accompaniments.
